question: In July 2019, which tennis player was conferred Arjuna Award (of 2018) by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohan Bopanna.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **July 2019**, tennis player **Rohan Bopanna** was conferred the **Arjuna Award (of 2018)** by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**.
 
• **Rohan Bopanna** is an Indian professional tennis player who specializes in doubles
